title: The engine gets a generic core
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The engine's match loop no longer knows it is running tanks: the tick, the seeded randomness, the state hash and the replay format now sit behind one interface a game implements. The tank rules are the one game that does so today, still inside the engine. Every match plays exactly as before, byte for byte, natively and in the browser, at the same speed. The engine docs also now describe the Tank Arena functions the viewer calls, with an example that was run.
next: moving the tank rules out of the engine waits until a second Rust game exists.
